Editor: a Scratchpad (Window > Scratchpad) for layers kept for the future - never drawn in the editor nor added to the game, whatever their visibility, as if they were not in the project. A second list next to editor_layers::order (editor_layers::scratchpad), saved under "scratchpad_layers" in the map's JSON and read only by the editor (reading_settings::read_scratchpad) - the game, servers and the tutorial never load these layers or their nodes, so code walking the layers sees nothing of them by default; the few places walking node pools directly (flavours, the waypoint preview, the node chooser) leave them out. The window has the Layers window's controls (no new layer, no clone; the eye does nothing), opens as a tab next to Layers, says what it is for when empty. Layers move with Right click > Move to Scratchpad / Restore to Layers or by drag & drop onto the other window or its tab (a yellow border shows where), one undoable step (reorder_layers_command::to_scratchpad); the inspector of a scratchpad layer or node only offers Restore to Layers. Its selection is kept apart from the other layers', Delete works on its own window's selection. Layers start collapsed; which are expanded is remembered per user in editor_view.json (open_layers, unknown names ignored) instead of "is_open_in_editor" in the map. The Window menu checks the open windows and toggles them. Double clicking a layer in the scratchpad expands it too.
